subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should OpenClaw adopt these five memory role slots, per-agent overrides, and hook-level role gating as the permanent public plugin and configuration contract?
rationale: Tests can validate implementation behavior, but they cannot choose the long-term API breadth, defaults, compatibility window, or ownership semantics OpenClaw should promise.

options.title: Sponsor the five-role contract
options.body: Approve the proposed API direction and require current-head compatibility and runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the initial contract
options.body: Land only roles with complete invocation semantics and defer dreaming or user-model ownership.

options.title: Pause this architecture
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open while maintainers choose a different memory composition model.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the five-role contract
recommendation.body: Approve the proposed API direction and require current-head compatibility and runtime proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Official governance and central plugin-runtime history make this person the strongest available owner for the permanent public API decision.
